gloss: large room; shared (hospital) room; communal dressing room

definitions.explanation: A spacious room shared by multiple people. Most often refers to a shared hospital ward, but also used for the communal dressing room of junior actors or for any large multi-person room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部屋|おおべや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father is in a shared room at the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{大部屋|おおべや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: A shared room is cheaper than a private room.

examples.japanese: {若手俳優|わかてはいゆう}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽屋|がくや}→楽屋：08376_gakuya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部屋|おおべや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出番|でばん}→出番：11733_deban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The young actors were waiting in the communal dressing room for their turn on stage.

notes:
Composed of {大|おお} (large) + {部屋|べや} (room; the rendaku form of ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧). Most common in the hospital sense, in contrast to ⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧ (private room).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大部屋|おおべや}: a shared hospital room
- {大部屋|おおべや}⟦{病室|びょうしつ}→病室：21074_byoushitsu⟧: shared ward
- {大部屋|おおべや}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: a bit-part actor (one who shares a communal dressing room)
- {大部屋|おおべや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: spend time in a large/shared room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個室|こしつ}→個室：11535_koshitsu⟧: private room — the opposite, especially for hospitals
- ⟦{相部屋|あいべや}→相部屋：18274_aibeya⟧: shared room (in lodging) — used for hotels and dorms
- {広間|ひろま}: large hall — emphasizes a large open space, often for gatherings
